liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **#Thunder** (1 other source): Strong wind and rain blew sideways for roughly ten minutes during this song, which also included a Jessica tease [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Southbound**: back after 65 archived shows (415 days); rare: 8 archived performances [5]
- **Eat My Dust**: rare: 3 archived performances [5]
- **Hellbinder**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Down Yonder**: rare: 7 archived performances [5]
- **Away From Te Mire**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **@How Long Have I Been Waiting On You?**: back after 69 archived shows (443 days); rare: 4 archived performances [5]
- **Dark Hollow**: back after 74 archived shows (499 days); rare: 12 archived performances [5]
- **Ralph's Banjo Special**: rare: 8 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2024-04-21** (recommended): source not stated; 30 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer says the recording captures the sound of the Meyer sound system the band tours with [4]
- **billystrings2024-04-21.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 29 songs; 173 min [2]
- **billystrings2024-04-21.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 173 min [3]

## Around the show

- The band stood at the front of the stage and played into one old-style can microphone for part of the show [1]
- For How Long Have I Been Waiting On You? and Freedom, the band gathered at the stage front around a single microphone [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2024-04-21**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II (48/32) [1]
- **billystrings2024-04-21.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Baby NBox>Zoom F3 [2]
- **billystrings2024-04-21.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Baby NBox>Zoom F3 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings St. Augustine Amp N1 2024 Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/st-augustine-amp-n1-2024-poster-regular/) [6]
